name: Ertai
description: A contender for the throne of Rath who intervenes on Crovax's behalf and kills Vuel with flowstone.

description_citations.text: "Volrath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin trained the young Ertai.
timeline.quote: Barrin is the teacher who trained the young Ertai.

citation.text: Barrin (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri resists the urge to kill Ertai as he boasts.
timeline.quote: Mirri's hackles rose as Ertai continued expounding his virtues.

citation.text: Abjure (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai questions what Teferi thought he was doing.
timeline.quote: "I don't like to speak ill of 'walkers . . . but just what did Teferi think he was doing?"

citation.text: Teferi's Veil (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hanna loses a competition to Ertai, who then derides her artifacts.
timeline.quote: Hanna challenged Ertai to a competition which she ultimately lost

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Predator and Weatherlight duel as Weatherlight races to the portal Ertai holds open; Weatherlight escapes and both ships are heavily damaged.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight just managed to get to the portal and escape her pursuer, with both vessels sustaining major damage.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Predator battles Weatherlight over Urborg; Ertai captures Gerrard and teleports him into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: managed to capture Gerrard and teleport him directly into the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai says he is too modest to reveal his abilities.
timeline.quote: "I'm too modest a wizard to reveal the full extent of my abilities."

citation.text: Abeyance (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai begins meditating at the portal and realizes he is not alone.
timeline.quote: Alone at the portal, Ertai began his meditation.

citation.text: Soltari Emissary (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai volunteers to open the portal.
timeline.quote: Ertai volunteered to open the portal.

citation.text: Ancient Runes (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barrin provides Ertai as the Weatherlight's mage; Ertai defeats Hanna in a contest.
timeline.quote: Ertai challenged Hanna to a competition which he won easily.

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Journey to Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Ertai opens a portal with Lyna's help but is left behind as the Weatherlight flees Predator.
timeline.quote: the Weatherlight was being hotly pursued by Predator as it fled, and so was forced to leave Ertai behind.

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Journey to Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai proposes taking 5,000 hostages from the human communities to prevent rebellion, and Greven rounds them up.
timeline.quote: Ertai came up with the plan to take 5,000 hostages from the three human communities

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven interrupts Crovax's coronation, Volrath resumes his true form, and Crovax defeats him in a duel after Ertai interferes.
timeline.quote: Ertai interfered by magically off-balancing Volrath, allowing Crovax to triumph.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lyna tells Hanna that Ertai has prepared the portal off Rath and the crew leaves.
timeline.quote: When the soltari Lyna appeared to inform her that Ertai had prepared the portal off of Rath and demanded that they leave

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax defeats Greven, fails against the Skyshroud rebels, and impales 6,000 hostages on flowstone spikes.
timeline.quote: Crovax impaled the hostages on flowstone spikes.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax forces Belbe by coup to name him evincar, then defeats Volrath in a duel thanks to Ertai.
timeline.quote: With his victory over Volrath, Crovax's Coronation was a fact and his reign as evincar began.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven il-Vec captures Ertai and takes him to the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Ertai was captured by Greven il -Vec and taken back to the Stronghold

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai secretly helps Crovax win the duel against Volrath.
timeline.quote: he used his magic to off-balance Volrath at a critical moment and thus give Crovax the victory

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri kills Belbe and flees to Dominaria, leaving Ertai to submit to Crovax.
timeline.quote: Belbe was killed by Eladamri

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai suspects Barrin taught him meditation to shut him up.
timeline.quote: Part of me believes that Barrin taught me meditation simply to shut me up.

citation.text: Meditate (Oversized League Prizes, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai asks whether that was all.
timeline.quote: Was that *it*?

citation.text: Ertai, Wizard Adept (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lyna cries that Ertai reports the portal is open though not for long.
timeline.quote: Ertai sends word that the portal is open—but not for long!

citation.text: Erratic Portal (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai stands alone, focused on opening the arcane portal before his comrades return.
timeline.quote: He must open the arcane portal before his comrades return from the dark fortress

citation.text: "Exodus", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai agrees to join the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: Ertai agrees to join the crew

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Ertai's Tale" (Hannovi Braddock)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai defeats a fog elemental with the Chimeric Sphere.
timeline.quote: attacks from the mists surrounding the hill, which Ertai defeats by piloting the Chimeric Sphere with a Mind Stone

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Ertai's Tale" (Hannovi Braddock)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lyna and Ertai strike a bargain over the portal.
timeline.quote: she would help him open the portal, and in return, he would allow her and her people to pass through it

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight leaves Ertai behind on Rath.
timeline.quote: they were forced to leave Ertai behind on Rath

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Predator slams into the closing portal and Ertai falls at Greven's feet.
timeline.quote: the Predator slammed into it, causing Ertai to fall into the wreckage at the feet of the furious Greven il- Vec

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai dismisses a countered spell as probably lousy.
timeline.quote: It was probably a lousy spell in the first place.

citation.text: Counterspell (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai, tested on the Chimeric Sphere, activates it against a fog elemental, which destroys it.
timeline.quote: Ertai ended his abeyance spell and activated the sphere

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai recalls Barrin teaching that the hardest lessons are those already learned.
timeline.quote: the hardest lessons to grasp are the ones you've already learned.

citation.text: Relearn (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath returns to find his throne contested by Greven, Ertai and Crovax, and duels Crovax; Ertai's intervention lets Crovax win.
timeline.quote: Ertai had intervened on Crovax's behalf, off-balancing Volrath and allowing his opponent to secure his victory.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Crovax's coronation Vuel, stripped of his Phyrexian implants, is executed with flowstone manipulated by Ertai.
timeline.quote: Vuel was injected with a vial of liquid flowstone

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai chides an opponent with 'Temper, temper.'
timeline.quote: Temper, temper.

citation.text: Chill (Arena League 2000, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Belbe restores order at the Stronghold and shortlists Crovax, Greven il-Vec and Ertai as evincar, preferring Ertai.
timeline.quote: Ertai made the best impression on her

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Belbe grows disillusioned with Phyrexia, disables the Eye of Yawgmoth, and falls in love with Ertai.
timeline.quote: She disabled the Eye of Yawgmoth implanted in her

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax organizes a coup and Belbe is forced to crown him evincar after a showdown with Ertai and the returning Volrath.
timeline.quote: Crovax organized a coup d'état to force her to declare him evincar

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax holds a funeral for Belbe at Volrath's execution, and a twisted four-armed Ertai takes her skull from the pyre.
timeline.quote: a twisted, four-armed Ertai reached into the smoldering pyre and secreted away Belbe's skull

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax executes Volrath, buries Belbe, and has Ertai compleated.
timeline.quote: He also had Ertai compleated into a Phyrexian and made him his court mage.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Weatherlight escapes Rath, Ertai is captured aboard the Predator and Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril shapes him into Volrath's successor.
timeline.quote: Ertai is captured and held aboard the Predator

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax rapidly outpaces rivals in the Evincar succession contest; Greven prefers servitude and Ertai augments himself.
timeline.quote: Ertai proves no match for Crovax's rapid ascent.

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai and Belbe fall in love, Belbe sabotages flowstone production, and the Oracle en-Vec names Eladamri Korvecdal.
timeline.quote: Ertai and Belbe develop a romantic bond

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath returns from Mercadia to challenge Crovax but Ertai sabotages him.
timeline.quote: Volrath, returned from Mercadia

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax becomes undisputed Evincar, Volrath is executed, and Ertai becomes Crovax's mutated servant.
timeline.quote: Crovax stands as the undisputed Evincar of Rath.

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai captures Gerrard and Squee and teleports them to the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: where he captured Gerrard (and, accidentally, Squee ) and teleported them into the Stronghold

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee overloads a Phyrexian healing device, killing Ertai in the explosion.
timeline.quote: killing Ertai in the explosion

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Squee are captured by Ertai, now a Phyrexian minion.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Squee were captured by a new minion of the Phyrexians: Ertai

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Stronghold Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Karn takes control of the Predator; Ertai steals Gerrard and Squee to Crovax, who sends Gerrard into Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: In a duel, Tahngarth killed Greven il-Vec and Karn took control of the Predator

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coalition storms the Stronghold as Gerrard kills Crovax and Squee kills Ertai.
timeline.quote: even as Gerrard killed Crovax and Squee killed Ertai

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai taunts Gerrard about the crew's rescue.
timeline.quote: I'm sure the crew will come to your rescue as quickly as they came to mine.

citation.text: Ertai's Trickery (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax tells Ertai he will kill him a hundred times a day as Yawgmoth's reward.
timeline.quote: I shall kill him a hundred times a day.

citation.text: Phyrexian Tyranny (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai reveals himself and teleports Gerrard and Squee into the Stronghold, where Crovax kills Squee to prove Yawgmoth can bring back the dead.
timeline.quote: To prove it he kills Squee, who is then granted the ability to come back from the dead.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard lands in the Stronghold throne room, reunites with Squee, and they defeat Phyrexian troops; Ertai summons Crovax back.
timeline.quote: Ertai realizes he can't defeat Gerrard and summons Crovax back to the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills Crovax, Squee fries Ertai, and the Dominarian forces escape on the Weatherlight as lava engulfs the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Gerrard kills Crovax with an axe

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai strikes a deal with the Soltari emissary Lyna to open the portal.
timeline.quote: Ertai made a deal with Lyna

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses the portal boosted by the Skyshaper, leaving Ertai behind on Rath.
timeline.quote: he was unable to save him, leaving him behind on Rath.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Predator crashes into the portal, tumbling Ertai at Greven's feet, ending the assault.
timeline.quote: The Predator crashed into the portal, sending Ertai tumbling at Greven il-Vec

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai emerges from the cave with Aron Capashen, now compleated.
timeline.quote: And Aron Capashen stepped from the cave's mouth.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai orders Aron to attack Danitha, and Danitha beheads her father.
timeline.quote: separating his head from his shoulders.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai summons a Phyrexian dreadnought from the mountain.
timeline.quote: A Phyrexian monstrosity broke free from the mountain in front of them

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai threatens to have the dreadnought kill everyone unless Jaya and Ajani surrender, and Danitha stops the fight.
timeline.quote: "If you don't give yourselves up to me," Ertai said

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai threatens that Sheoldred will hear of this, and the dreadnought collapses.
timeline.quote: Ertai bellowed, "Sheoldred will hear of this!"

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee revives, sees the whole clan with gold-ringed eyes, and a rotting spell kills him again; the disguised Bulp is revealed to be Ertai.
timeline.quote: Ertai's spiked Phyrexian armor gleamed in the torchlight as the rot reached Squee's chest.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai explains how Sheoldred found him and says he wants Squee to beg for death, and reveals he took the Salvation Sphere.
timeline.quote: "Or maybe, I came here to make an unkillable goblin beg for death.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Compleated goblins restrain Squee and sedate him on a table made of their fused bodies.
timeline.quote: One of the goblins had become a table, and Squee was shifted onto it.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee awakens compleated, Ertai plans to deliver him to New Phyrexia for study, and Squee shows his new weapons.
timeline.quote: "You won't be a king in New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee declares himself compleat; his arm blade severs the rope holding boulders, which crush him and set off a chain explosion of mana lamps that destroys the mountain.
timeline.quote: there was a smoldering crater of stone.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai, now a Phyrexian with doubled arms, leaps onto the Mana Rig and confronts Karn.
timeline.quote: It's been quite some time, old friend.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai's spell freezes Karn's joints, lifts him and begins to crush and pull him apart limb by limb.
timeline.quote: He was pulling Karn apart, limb by limb, like a cruel child torturing an insect.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives on the Golden Argosy and knocks Ertai off the Mana Rig, freeing Karn.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian mage stumbled backwards, concentration broken—and with a scream, tumbled over the side of the Mana Rig.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Centuries later Sheoldred reconstitutes Ertai, who takes control of the new academy at Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: Ertai was reconstituted by the dark sciences of Sheoldred

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai compleats Aron Capashen and Squee's goblin clan.
timeline.quote: He compleated Aron Capashen and Squee's clan of goblins

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of the Mana Rig Ertai leads an attack on Karn and is last seen stumbling over the edge before its self-destruction.
timeline.quote: He was last seen stumbling over the edge of the Rig before its self-destruction.

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Aerona Jaya fights compleated Ertai and Aron Capashen and is rescued by Radha, then is killed by compleated Ajani at the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: She was killed by a compleated Ajani Goldmane at the Battle of the Mana Rig .

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone Dihada disposes of the Tolarian Academy's archmage, and Ertai and the Society of Mishra later turn it into a haven for dark research.
timeline.quote: Geyadrone Dihada disposed of the Academy's archmage and took his place.

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred allies with the Society of Mishra, Rona and a resurrected Ertai, raising an army of compleated Argivians and sleeper agents.
timeline.quote: The invasion began when Sheoldred , the Whispering One, allied with the Society of Mishra

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sleeper agents abduct Aron Capashen at the Oyster Bay peace summit; Ertai oversees his compleation.
timeline.quote: Aron's compleation was personally overseen by Ertai

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred mass-produces sleeper agents, resurrects Ertai, and compleats Ajani Goldmane.
timeline.quote: resurrected Ertai , and compleated the planeswalker Ajani Goldmane

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai, resurrected as a Phyrexian, takes control of the Lat-Nam academy.
timeline.quote: took control of the academy at Lat-Nam

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "The new Tolarian Academies". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Ertai tells of his usual meetings with his teacher Barrin
